descricao_original: This image shows the dermal-epidermal junction with downwardly-directed epidermal pegs (ridges) and upwardly-directed dermal papilla. Meissner’s corpuscles are located at the apex of sensory dermal papillae and provide fine touch discrimination. Other dermal papillae, called vascular papillae, contain small blood vessels. 800x
creditos_identificados: Image credit: This image was taken of a slide in the Duke University collection.
